lines.speaker: Drek
lines.text: Pale Choir's been running cargo and prisoners through the marrow-tunnels for months. Dominion wants the nest cleared.

lines.speaker: Drek
lines.text: Station command doesn't care what's in the tunnels. Dead space. Real estate now.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: What was it before the dead space?

lines.speaker: Drek
lines.text: Before?

lines.speaker: Drek
lines.text: Don't know. Don't ask. The leviathan was a creature. Now it's a resource.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Choir. Are they organized?

lines.speaker: Drek
lines.text: Religious. Keep to themselves. They're tending something down in the bone-chambers. Not aggressive unless you breach their perimeter.

lines.speaker: Choir Cultist 1
lines.text: The gate is sealed to the unworthy.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I'm not leaving.

lines.speaker: Dying Cultist
lines.text: Why don't you run?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I need to know what you're guarding.

lines.speaker: Dying Cultist
lines.text: Because we're already inside the corpse of a god. The Dominion made sure of that. They fed it to death, and we feed it our devotion.

lines.speaker: Dying Cultist
lines.text: You're just another ghost, samurai.

lines.speaker: Meren
lines.text: You're Dominion. Or you were.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: We're not here for residents.

lines.speaker: Meren
lines.text: You're here for the Choir. They've been running this settlement's water and air-recycle systems for two generations. They came with my grandmother.

lines.speaker: Meren
lines.text: The leviathan was a living oracle. Worshipped. It knew things.

lines.speaker: Meren
lines.text: Forty years ago the Dominion cut off its food supply. Said it was a cultural liability. Let it starve.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: And now?

lines.speaker: Meren
lines.text: Now it's a resource. Its bones are real estate. Its death bought us shelter and employment and the Choir bought us hope that maybe something in this creature would be remembered.

lines.speaker: Bloodied Elder
lines.text: We have been waiting for the one who fired the Genesis Cannon.

lines.speaker: Bloodied Elder
lines.text: The leviathan has been calling you home.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: The leviathan was a living records-keeper. An alien species that absorbed and preserved all knowledge it encountered.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: We call them thought-oracles. The Dominion called them a problem.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Why would it be a problem?

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: Because it remembered everything. Every atrocity. Every order. Every secret the Dominion wanted buried.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: So they took a ship with a Genesis Cannon and killed a god. Then they walked away from what they'd done and called the corpse real estate.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: The Choir has spent four decades keeping its residual neural tissue intact. We are its voice now.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: And it has been singing your designation since the day you pressed the trigger.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: It wants to show you. Put your hand to the thought-fossil.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: Are you ready?

lines.speaker: Khall (Memory)
lines.text: The oracle has absorbed too many Dominion records. It is a liability.

lines.speaker: Khall (Memory)
lines.text: Purge it. Use the Genesis Cannon.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: Now you know what they built you to protect.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Cipher. A Dominion capital ship is descending. Not to hold the station. To crack the creature open and destroy the Archive.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: One word from command: Khall. You need to move now.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: How long until impact?

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: Minutes. You need to reach the heart-chamber. The settlement is there. The Dominion will level it.

lines.speaker: Dominion Assault Commander
lines.text: Structure is hostile! Multiple threats converging!

lines.speaker: Meren
lines.text: Hold the east corridor! The settlement stays intact!

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: You remember now.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You gave the order.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: I gave you a blank slate. A mercy. The weight of that trigger was mine to carry, not yours.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You wiped me because I refused an order. The blank slate kept your program intact. Not me.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: The cannon fires in fifteen minutes. The only question is whether you spend them here or saving something that matters.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You've got three minutes before the cannon fires!

lines.speaker: Dominion Weapons Officer
lines.text: Targeting relay is non-responsive! Firing solution compromised!

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: The Archive is secure. The confessions, the schematics, the proof of the cage, all preserved.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: What comes next?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Kethel-7.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The massacre.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The original wound. The first order I refused. Everything the Dominion built around that refusal.

lines.speaker: Sallow
lines.text: Then you go there. You face it directly.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Leviathan-9 was a living thought-oracle, a sentient archive that absorbed and preserved all knowledge it encountered. The Dominion murdered it forty years ago with a Genesis Cannon because it remembered every atrocity, every order, every secret they wanted buried. The Pale Choir preserved its residual neural tissue in the Archive. When I touched the thought-fossil, I remembered. I fired the cannon. Khall gave the order. But the Archive showed me something deeper, the ten syndicates of the fringe are not rivals. They are a cage. Each bar holding the others in place.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: So the heading is Kethel-7, the orphanage, the massacre, the first order you ever refused. The original wound. Everything you have been circling leads back to that origin point. This is where they built the cage. Where they designed you to carry a burden that was never yours to bear. Where you face it directly, and where you choose what comes next.
